tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Sequences of peptides examined. Peptide sequences are shown relative to the primary amino acid sequence of the Tat peptide. Position numbers are derived from the full-length Tat protein amino acid sequence (HIV-1 strain SF2) [21].

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Viral titer does not affect the antiviral activity of Tat peptide. EC50 values were calculated from the results of antiviral assays (as described in Section 2) involving infection by HIV-1 IIIB at three different multiplicities of infection (MOI).
header_rows: Virus concentration during infection (103 infectious virions/mL)
grid: Virus concentration during infection (103 infectious virions/mL)
